doc: M2-RND-02 underwater look: UnderwaterRig (game/world/water/underwater/underwater_rig.gd). docs/kb/tech/underwater.md. Colours are palette.json swatches (named in `swatches`, tested).

optics._note: transmit is the colour white light keeps after transmit_distance_m of water (sigma = -ln(transmit) / distance, per channel: red goes first). scatter is the in-scatter colour near the surface, fading toward deep with depth below the surface over depth_falloff_m and when looking down. ior gives the Snell window (asin(1/ior) = 48.6 deg). The in-scatter's light level weights the camera's own depth by camera_light_weight (the rest: the path's middle). sun_disc and sun_halo brighten the refracted sun inside the Snell window. The light level is the scene's visible directional lights (energy x colour luminance) over light_reference (a noon sun), at least light_floor: it scales the in-scatter and the underside, so a night dive is dark and the lantern carries it. M2-RND-09 (Art, M2-ART-02): scatter and transmit are lagoon_teal (the lagoon's water look), deep is deep_teal_shadow (Act I), and TIR is deep_teal_shadow x tir_gain (about the old on-screen value; sea_glow is emission only, never a lit surface). At night the water column carries sea_glow emission at the zone WaterSurface's sea_glow_energy x sea_glow_strength, independent of the light level (colour script rule 3). M2-RND-09: the waterline is antialiased in screen space and its meniscus is meniscus_px wide (it was a 3 cm world band).

god_rays._note: A FogVolume under the surface whose density is constant along the sun's direction, so the volumetric fog draws shafts. Only on tiers with god_rays and volumetric fog on. The fog's albedo is the scatter colour mixed toward white by albedo_white_mix, so Rhen's oil lamp keeps a warm halo instead of turning green. M2-RND-09: the lamp's halo no longer comes from the fog (lantern.halo_*), so the shafts keep the 0.5 mix.

particulate._note: Marine snow in a box around the camera.

lantern._note: Rhen's oil lamp (decisions_log N-02): the hero light underwater. M2-RND-09: the halo is the underwater post's own single scattering of the lamp (halo_strength x energy, falling over halo_range_m with attenuation and a halo_core_m core, halo_steps samples), absorbed only between the lamp, each point and the camera: warm by the lamp, cooling to teal further out. fog_energy is 0, so volumetric fog doesn't add a second, green halo absorbed over the whole background path. halo_absorption 0.35: the halo loses less red than the water behind it (Art: physics yields to the last warm light).

looks._note: UnderwaterRig.look overrides colours per zone look (M2-RND-09): night_sea zones (ch20, ch21, night dives) keep the abyss_navy deep.

glimmer._note: M2-RND-09 item 5: motes seen by a camera underwater get their path's absorption back (core and halo divided by the transmittance, mixed by this share): released (glimmer_lift, rising) fully, held 0.6. A GlimmerField's underwater_compensation scales it (0 opts out). max_gain caps it per channel, so no core reads above its swatch's on-screen +1.
